<function name="ClientsideScene" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Creates a scene entity based on the scene name and the entity.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="name" type="string">The name of the scene.</arg>
		<arg name="targetEnt" type="Entity">The entity to play the scene on.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="CSEnt">C_SceneEntity</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Plays "I guess you should go with Alyx" line from HL2.</description>
	<code>ClientsideScene( "scenes/eli_lab/mo_gowithalyx01.vcd", LocalPlayer() )</code>

</example>
